method: Each licensed source is centre-cropped to 800×1000 RGBA and rendered at 400×500 mm. Pearson correlation compares mean source darkness with relative dot area in a 12×16 physical grid. The per-bin normalization uses the identical all-black lattice. This measures coarse tonal structure, not likeness, comfort, accessibility, real ink colour or print quality. Runtime is one local Node run per image and excludes decode/export; it is not a browser performance guarantee.
